- scripts/security_pass_skip.py: CLI fast-path branch (around the `_stub_gh` `repos/o/r/issues/<n>` test surface); corresponding dual-label CLI test at tests/test_security_pass_skip.py:326-333
  PROBLEM: The CLI fast-path returns `{"skip": False, "label": None, "reason": "no skip label"}` for a single-labeled CI-derived `ai:workflow-heal` issue, while the pure decision path returns `{"skip": False, "label": None, "reason": "CI workflow heal requires security pass"}` for the same input.
  WHY: Both surface `skip=False`, so functionally the security pass still runs, but the reason text diverges between paths and the CLI fast path silently drops the CI-derived provenance that the issue body carries — downstream log scrapers that key off the reason string (`CI workflow heal requires security pass`) will not see those single-label cases.
  Suggested minimal fix: in the CLI fast path, when no skip label matches, scan the body for `CI_HEAL_CONTEXT_RE` (the same regex already imported) before returning `no skip label`; if it matches, return `{"skip": False, "label": None, "reason": "CI workflow heal requires security pass"}` to mirror the pure decision path. Five to seven lines, uses the existing constant.
